authority: owner review 2026-08-21; all four defects verified against artifacts before acceptance
method: APPEND_ONLY. Render-gate rules added and the 8/21 decision surface re-rendered. No forecast, card, grade or evidence file was modified; the underlying probabilities are unchanged.

defect_1_margin_sign.withdrawn: WNBA rows displayed 'model margin: WAS -7.23 spread points' / 'CHI -4.08', which reads as those teams being FAVORED and contradicts their own win probabilities (WAS 25.2%, CHI 36.5%).
defect_1_margin_sign.root_cause: the stored field is home_margin_pred = home points - away points. A negative value means the HOME team LOSES. The betting fair spread is its NEGATION. Rendering the raw field with a minus sign silently reused spread notation for a margin quantity.
defect_1_margin_sign.enforcement: decision_card.margin_display() emits team + direction in words AND the explicitly labeled fair spread; render_gate check #9 fails any margin lacking either. Selftest fixtures: a bare 'B -7.23' must fail; the correct wording must pass.
defect_1_margin_sign.repeat_offence: this is the SECOND time this surface defect has been corrected (first: 2026-08-20 TOR@WAS, where margin and fair spread were blended). It is now mechanical rather than editorial.

defect_2_delta_attribution.withdrawn: the column labeled 'Starter move vs v1' and prose such as 'Schlittler's addition moved New York 8.1 points' and 'Cameron moved Kansas City -7.5'.
why_wrong: the quantity is p_home(v2) - p_home(v1), an OBSERVED delta that contains starter information PLUS sequential-RNG coupling noise, because daily_card.py consumes one global RNG in slate order
attributing a game-level delta to ONE pitcher is over-attribution: in DET@KC both Melton and Cameron changed from league-average simultaneously, so neither can be credited alone
the keyed-seed/high-n harness already exists and is the only noise-separated figure available
defect_2_delta_attribution.correct_treatment: show BOTH: the observed delta (labeled as such) and the keyed-seed reference figure. Only the latter may be called a starter effect, and even then it is a joint effect of both slots that changed.
defect_2_delta_attribution.enforcement: decision_card.delta_display(); render_gate check #10 fails any text calling a delta a 'starter effect' without the keyed-seed reference.

defect_3_completeness_denominator.withdrawn: 'starters 80% resolved' shown beside a slot-level narrative.

exact_accounting.game_level_alternative: 10 of 15 games fully resolved on both sides (66.7%); 5 of 15 carry at least one league-average slot

defect_3_completeness_denominator.source_of_the_80_percent: harness/pregame_preflight.py counts GAMES that carry a TBD *name*: 12 of 15 = 80.0%. That denominator silently excludes Wesneski, who is named (so not TBD) but registry-missing (so still league-average). Three different denominators were in play at once and none was labeled.
defect_3_completeness_denominator.owner_figure_confirmed: 26/30 = 86.7% model-resolved with four CAP slots is exactly right.
defect_3_completeness_denominator.enforcement: decision_card.completeness_display() prints numerator, denominator and the NAMED unit; render_gate check #11 fails any bare 'NN% resolved' string in the decision text.

defect_4_neutral_site.withdrawn: 'that 61.2% should be discounted by an unknown amount' — not an executable correction, as the owner noted.
defect_4_neutral_site.applies_to: PDX@TOR 2026-08-21, played at Rogers Arena Vancouver while Toronto is nominally home; the frozen WNBA feature set has no neutral-site term and applied a full home-court advantage.
semantics: survives prices arriving — it is NOT a no-prices block
the row REMAINS in the immutable WINNER validation cohort (the forecast is registered and will grade)
and remains in the complete ATS diagnostic cohort if the frozen preregistration requires it
it is blocked from CARD ACTION only — the same registration/action/settlement separation ratified on 2026-08-20
defect_4_neutral_site.enforcement: PERMANENT_BLOCKS in decision_card.py; render_gate check #8 fails any OUT_OF_DOMAIN row whose action is not BLOCKED. Selftest fixture included.

defect_5_cross_model_contamination.withdrawn: the suggestion that MIN@WAS at 74.8% deserves extra scepticism because a DIFFERENT model's most-confident MLB pick lost on 2026-08-20.
defect_5_cross_model_contamination.why_wrong: that is cross-model contamination of reasoning. The MLB V13 simulation and the WNBA ridge-logit shadow are separate models with separate validation histories; one model's miss carries no information about another model's calibration. The 8/20 finding was explicitly narrowed by the owner to a statement about V13 on that slate.
defect_5_cross_model_contamination.correct_treatment: MIN@WAS warrants ROUTINE high-confidence review — the same scrutiny any high-confidence forecast gets — and nothing more.
defect_5_cross_model_contamination.owner_wording: it should not be discounted because a different MLB model's most-confident prediction lost yesterday.
